Production C ABI, audio-device callback, native 48 kHz GPU or other GPU models
notes: Normal desktop load; every timeout counted. No parallel task builds or benchmarks during timed runs.
All formal candidate runs use the same frozen executable, DLL and kernel source.
The old and candidate DLL paired screen uses the same new Rust executable, differing only in EQ backend capability. It is one pair, not a statistical speedup guarantee.
44 room preparations took 90.0250368 seconds outside DSP timing; this cannot excuse or offset the failed deadline gate.
The old DLL was not run in the same repeated-switch long workload; do not attribute all long-test degradation to EQ offload from cross-workload history.
Default and world-only outputs each have 231581 frames, input length 96013, actual post-EOS output 135568 and unchanged latency 256. Static manifest tail_frames is the initial room value.
Short/paired collector scope prose was normalized; numerical and timing values are unchanged.
